title: Mongo: ACL list + grant
description: Runs `nexus acl mongo list` (db.getUsers) then `nexus acl mongo grant` (createUser/grantRolesToUser). Idempotent grant.

steps.command: nexus acl mongo grant --user demo-reader --permissions read --yes

observe.what: demo-reader created with read@admin; the command re-describes the user to confirm

whatProves: MongoAdapter.AclAsync reads users via db.getUsers() (userAdminAnyDatabase) and idempotently grants roles via createUser/grantRolesToUser.
